rules.rationale: This is the macro equation that expands numberKeyClosure to the exact closure value for the translated helper body; it defines a named proof term and does not perform or replace execution.
This is the macro equation that expands sortNumbersClosure to the exact closure value for the translated target body; it defines a named proof term and does not perform or replace execution.

This unconditional equation defines isNumberWord as equality with one of the ten permitted numeral-string values; it is the defining equation of a total domain predicate, not an additional fact about an existing symbol.
This equation is the empty-sequence base case of the structural definition of allNumberWords.
This equation is the constructor-recursive case of allNumberWords, defining the predicate by checking the head and recurring on the strict tail.

This unconditional equation defines expectedSortNumbers as the named composition of splitWS, sortKeyVS, and joinCodes; it abbreviates the symbolic result and does not assert an extra property of those operations.
